# Creación de base de datos

```{r}
# Brand Shares en formato largo

Brand_shares_long <- Brand_shares %>%
  mutate(
    across(`2016`:`2025`, ~ na_if(as.character(.), "-"))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = `2016`:`2025`,
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "Brand_Share"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.numeric(Year),
    Brand_Share = readr::parse_number(
      Brand_Share,
      locale = locale(grouping_mark = ",")
    ),
    Brand_Present = if_else(
      !is.na(Brand_Share) & Brand_Share > 0,
      1L,
      0L
    )
  )

# Identificar lanzamiento de una nueva marca

Brand_shares_long <- Brand_shares_long %>%
  group_by(
    Geography,
    Category,
    `Brand Name`,
    `Company Name (GBO)`,
    `Data Type`
  ) %>%
  arrange(Year, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    New_Brand = if_else(
      Brand_Present == 1 &
        lag(Brand_Present, default = 1) == 0,
      1L,
      0L
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# Revisar lanzamientos identificados

Brand_shares_long %>%
  filter(New_Brand == 1) %>%
  select(
    Geography,
    Category,
    `Brand Name`,
    `Company Name (GBO)`,
    Year,
    Brand_Share
  ) %>%
  arrange(Year, Category)

# Número de lanzamientos por año

Brand_shares_long %>%
  filter(New_Brand == 1) %>%
  count(Year, name = "Num_Launches")
```

## Colapsar Brand Shares

```{r}
# Brand Shares a nivel empresa-categoría-año

brand_company_year <- Brand_shares_long %>%
  group_by(
    Geography,
    Category,
    `Company Name (GBO)`,
    Year
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Num_Brands = sum(Brand_Present, na.rm = TRUE),
    Num_New_Brands = sum(New_Brand, na.rm = TRUE),
    New_Brand = as.integer(Num_New_Brands > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Company_shares

```{r}
# Company Shares en formato largo

Company_shares_long <- Company_shares %>%
  mutate(
    across(`2016`:`2025`, ~ na_if(as.character(.), "-"))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = `2016`:`2025`,
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "Company_Share"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.numeric(Year),
    Company_Share = readr::parse_number(
      Company_Share,
      locale = locale(grouping_mark = ",")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
revision_merge <- full_join(
  Company_shares_long %>%
    mutate(master = 1),
  
  brand_company_year %>%
    rename(`Company Name` = `Company Name (GBO)`) %>%
    mutate(using = 1),
  
  by = c(
    "Geography",
    "Category",
    "Company Name",
    "Year"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    merge = case_when(
      !is.na(master) & is.na(using) ~ 1,
      is.na(master) & !is.na(using) ~ 2,
      !is.na(master) & !is.na(using) ~ 3
    )
  )

table(revision_merge$merge)
```

```{r}
# Creación de base final

base_final <- Company_shares_long %>%
  left_join(
    brand_company_year,
    by = c(
      "Geography",
      "Category",
      "Company Name" = "Company Name (GBO)",
      "Year"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    `Company Name` != "Total",
    Category != "Beauty and Personal Care"
  )

# Eliminar observaciones sin información de tratamiento

base_final <- base_final %>%
  filter(!is.na(New_Brand))
```

## Market Sizes

```{r}
# Market Sizes en formato largo

Market_sizes_long <- Market_sizes %>%
  mutate(
    across(`2016`:`2025`, ~ na_if(as.character(.), "-"))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = `2016`:`2025`,
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "Market_Size"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.numeric(Year),
    Market_Size = readr::parse_number(
      Market_Size,
      locale = locale(grouping_mark = ",")
    )
  )

# Conservar tamaño de mercado comparable

Market_sizes_analysis <- Market_sizes_long %>%
  filter(
    `Data Type` == "Retail Value RSP",
    Unit == "MXN million",
    `Current Constant` == "Current Prices",
    Category %in% unique(base_final$Category)
  )
```

```{r}
# Agregar Market Size a la base final

base_final <- base_final %>%
  left_join(
    Market_sizes_analysis %>%
      select(
        Geography,
        Category,
        Year,
        Market_Size
      ),
    by = c(
      "Geography",
      "Category",
      "Year"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Ventas estimadas de cada empresa

base_final <- base_final %>%
  mutate(
    Estimated_Sales = (Company_Share / 100) * Market_Size
  )

# Cambio porcentual anual en ventas

base_final <- base_final %>%
  group_by(
    Geography,
    Category,
    `Company Name`
  ) %>%
  arrange(Year, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Sales_Change = if_else(
      lag(Estimated_Sales) == 0,
      NA_real_,
      ((Estimated_Sales - lag(Estimated_Sales)) /
         lag(Estimated_Sales)) * 100
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Crecimiento porcentual anual del mercado

base_final <- base_final %>%
  group_by(
    Geography,
    Category
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Market_Growth = (
      (Market_Size - Market_Size[match(Year - 1, Year)]) /
      Market_Size[match(Year - 1, Year)]
    ) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```
